title: Projects
text:
Featured projects




Fish Hydroacoustics Classification (ETC5543)
A machine learning project to classify fish species (e.g., lake trout vs smallmouth bass) using wideband hydroacoustic frequency features, with a focus on reproducible pipelines and model evaluation.

Tools: R, tidymodels, feature engineering, model tuning
Output: scripts, results tracking, and reproducible reporting

View on GitHub






Corporate Finance EDA (ETC5521 Project Part 1)
Exploratory data analysis on firm-level financial data, focusing on data quality, cleaning, and insightful summaries for business decision-making.

Tools: R, tidyverse, EDA workflows, reporting
Focus: structured exploration + clear communication

View on GitHub






Creating a Blog with Quarto (ETC5523 Assignment 3)
A Quarto website/blog project demonstrating content structure, site navigation, and publishing workflows.

Tools: Quarto, RStudio, Git/GitHub
Focus: building a clean static website and rendering/publishing

View on GitHub






Data Analysis & Reporting (ETC5513 Assignment 1)
An analysis/reporting project showcasing practical data work: cleaning, summarising, and presenting results clearly.

Tools: R, tidyverse, Quarto reporting
Focus: clean analysis + communication

View on GitHub
